test_title: English Language and Comprehension Mock Test 62

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.Her reaction was ______ measured than one might expect in such a volatile situation.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The project was completed in a ______ efficient manner than anticipated.

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A. It is a highly erosive crop that rapidly depletes soil nutrients.B. This requires more fertilisers to be used which further worsens soil quality.C. Up to 5.4 kg of wood is required to process 1 kg of tobacco.D. Tobacco’s deleterious influence extends beyond human health.E. The plant is also a major contributor to deforestation.
Select the correct positive question tag to complete the given sentence.The girl questioned, “You aren’t a doctor, _____?”

Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. The professor offered detailed instructions, but the intern still did things in his own way. When the system crashed, he washeld responsible. It was a classic case of someone who invited trouble by ignoring good advice.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (dug his own grave) है।

Comprehension:In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank. The concept of cultural memory plays a vital role in how societies understand their collective past. Unlike individual memory, which is often fragmented and subjective, cultural memory refers to shared narratives that are passed down through generations via texts, rituals, and institutions. This form of memory is not merely a passive recollection but an active process that both reflects and (1) _______ identity.In contemporary discourse, cultural memory is often invoked to examine how nations commemorate traumatic events. Monuments, museums, and literature serve as physical and symbolic (2) _______. However, cultural memory is not immune to distortion. Political agendas frequently shape what is remembered and what is (3) _______, revealing power dynamics within the act of remembering.Additionally, globalisation complicates the notion of cultural memory, as it introduces transnational narratives that may challenge or (4) _______ national ones. The task for scholars, therefore, is to analyse not only what is preserved but also how memory is framed and mediated.Ultimately, cultural memory serves as a site of both continuity and contestation, reminding us that memory is never static but constantly being (5) _______ and reinterpreted.Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
